claims.text: Who Gets the Second Slice of National Income?
claims.support: Percentage share of income or consumption is the share that accrues to subgroups of population indicated by deciles or quintiles.

claims.text: A cinematic tour of income distribution, comparing how much the lower-middle 20% of earners hold across 124 countries and territories.
Slovakia's lower-middle earners hold 15.3% of national income. South Africa: 6.9%.
claims.support: Slovak Republic value 15.3, South Africa value 6.9

claims.text: Slovakia is the world's highest. A larger portion of the national wealth goes to those just above the bottom.
South Africa is the world's lowest. Slovakia has 2.2 times the share South Africa provides.
claims.support: South Africa rank 124, Slovak Republic value 15.3 divided by South Africa value 6.9 is approximately 2.217

claims.text: It counts the share that goes to this subgroup of the population.
claims.support: Percentage share of income or consumption is the share that accrues to subgroups of population indicated by deciles or quintiles.

claims.text: India is a surprise near the top with 14.8%.
The USA and Mexico sit further down the map, both at 10%.
